# Walgreens

> > Walgreens is a comprehensive pharmacy and health & wellness retailer offering prescriptions, OTC medications, photo services, beauty products, and same-day delivery across the United States.

Walgreens serves millions of customers through its online platform and physical stores, providing integrated pharmacy services, health testing, seasonal promotions, and a loyalty rewards program (myWalgreens) with exclusive deals and cashback benefits.

## Key Topics

- myWalgreens membership
- Pharmacy & prescriptions
- Health & wellness
- Contact lenses
- Same-day delivery
- Walgreens Cash rewards
- Drug information
- Beauty products
- Seasonal promotions
- Vaccinations
- Testing services
- Photo services
- Discount codes
- Online retail
- myWalgreens Mastercard

## Shopping & Products

- [Walgreens Homepage](https://www.walgreens.com): Main Walgreens portal for pharmacy, health & wellness, prescriptions, and photo services
- [Product Catalog](https://www.walgreens.com/store/c/productlist/N=20007411): Walgreens product catalog with seasonal promotions and same-day delivery options
- [Contact Lenses](https://www.walgreens.com/store/c/contact-lenses/ID=350006-tier3contactlens): Contact lens shopping with brands like Acuvue, Dailies, and Biofinity

## Membership & Rewards

- [myWalgreens Dashboard](https://www.walgreens.com/mywalgreens/dashboard.jsp): myWalgreens membership dashboard for rewards, Walgreens Cash, and exclusive deals

## Health & Pharmacy Resources

- [Drug Information](https://www.walgreens.com/rx-druginfo/pharmacy/finddrug/druginfosearch): Drug information database for prescription and OTC medications with pharmacy resources

## Customer Service & Orders

- [Guest Order Lookup](https://www.walgreens.com/orderhistory/orders-ui): Guest order lookup and purchase history tracking for customer service
